complicacoes.texto: Doctor Luz is afraid of the dark (or, more specifically, what can happen under such conditions).

Doctor Luz draws Energia through her connection to the distant star, Vega, in order to fuel her Poderes. Others have been able to manipulate this conduit contra Luz’s Vontade, Desenho Energia from Vega through her. If the starlight connection is blocked or severed, Doctor Luz’s Poderes require ambient Luz to function. In such instances, her Poderes suffer a Weakness effect e won’t work in Total Escuridão. The Gamemaster determines the effect’s graduação, as suits lighting levels.
